about: Standard TEST firing-angle specs for QCFRM-012 (CPU-95), by Altronic Part Number. Read by src/lib/qcCpu95Fields.ts (the form and the blank sheet) and scripts/backfill-qc-cpu95-firing-specs.ps1. Angle for cylinder row i (0-based) = (floor(i/2) * pair + (i % 2) * offset) mod 360. 'cylinders' must match the unit's firing grid - a test checks it. A changed spec is a new value here; sheets already saved keep the spec they were tested to.

specs.source: Not on the 2025 sheets - the high-voltage twin of 791952-18 (Tim, 2026-10-21)
CPU-95C and 3516, both CAT16TST - pre-printed on the REV 2 workbook
